questions.question: Quel était l'ancien nom de Mondria ?
questions.answer: L'ancien nom de Mondria était GC Brieau [MON-01-01].

questions.question: Since when has Mondria been working with Canadian SMEs?
questions.answer: Mondria has been working with Canadian SMEs since 2009 [MON-01-01].

questions.question: Como a Mondria descreve o seu método de trabalho?
questions.answer: A Mondria descreve seu método de trabalho como parceiro de inteligência gerida, consistindo em clarificar as necessidades, planejar as prioridades, implementar as soluções e governar sua evolução [MON-01-02].

questions.question: Combien de PME Mondria a-t-elle accompagnées ?
questions.answer: Mondria indique avoir accompagné plus de 300 PME selon les données publiées sur son site [MON-01-03].

questions.question: How many years in a row has Mondria been in the MSP 501 ranking?
questions.answer: Mondria has been ranked in the MSP 501 for six consecutive years according to the published indicators [MON-01-03].

questions.question: Qual é o telefone da Mondria?
questions.answer: O telefone da Mondria é 1-888-400-1205 [MON-01-04].

questions.question: Where is Mondria's Boisbriand office?
questions.answer: Mondria's Boisbriand office is located at 1919, boulevard Lionel-Bertrand, bureau 102, Boisbriand (Québec) [MON-01-04].

questions.question: Mondria s'occupe-t-elle de la maintenance des postes et des serveurs ?
questions.answer: Oui, Mondria propose la surveillance, la maintenance et la gestion du parc informatique, incluant postes, serveurs et réseau, dans une optique de stabilité et de prévention des incidents [MON-02-01].

questions.question: Does Mondria manage Teams and SharePoint?
questions.answer: Yes, Mondria manages Teams and SharePoint as part of its Microsoft 365 services, which include identity management, access, Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive [MON-02-02].

questions.question: Como funciona o suporte técnico da Mondria?
questions.answer: O suporte técnico da Mondria utiliza um processo de triagem, escalonamento e acompanhamento. A empresa também oferece auditorias e projetos de TI, inventários, gestão de licenças e ciclo de vida dos equipamentos [MON-02-03].

questions.question: Les sauvegardes sont-elles testées ?
questions.answer: Oui, les sauvegardes sont testées selon les informations fournies dans les sections MON-03-03 et MON-02-04.

questions.question: Which security framework does Mondria base its cybersecurity on?
questions.answer: Mondria bases its cybersecurity approach on the CIS Controls framework, prioritizing measures according to risks, focusing on identities, access, emails, and workstations [MON-03-01].

questions.question: A Mondria usa autenticação multifator no Microsoft 365?
questions.answer: Sim, Mondria utiliza autenticação multifator como uma das medidas de proteção para Microsoft 365, conforme anunciado nas medidas de segurança que incluem a autenticação multifator, a gestão de permissões, o endurecimento dos acessos e a segurança dos e-mails [MON-03-02].

questions.question: Que fait Mondria en cas d'incident de sécurité ?
questions.answer: Mondria propose la surveillance des courriels, postes et accès, la détection des menaces, la réponse aux incidents, l'application de correctifs, ainsi que des sauvegardes testées et des scans d’exposition pour gérer les incidents de sécurité [MON-03-03].

questions.question: Can Mondria help with the documentation insurers ask for?
questions.answer: Yes, Mondria offers support for the documentation requested by insurers, including registers, incident management, and risk assessments for personal information. However, this does not guarantee compliance for every client [MON-03-04].

questions.question: Quelles solutions d'IA prêtes à déployer Mondria propose-t-elle ?
questions.answer: Mondria propose comme solutions d'IA prêtes à déployer notamment Microsoft 365 Copilot et Claude, selon la distinction faite entre accompagnement stratégique, solutions prêtes à déployer, et solutions sur mesure [MON-04-01].

questions.question: What are the steps of Mondria's AI method?
questions.answer: Mondria's AI method comprises four steps: 1) defining the objectives and use cases, 2) designing and deploying the solution, 3) supporting adoption, and 4) monitoring KPIs and evolving the solution [MON-04-02].

questions.question: Como a Mondria garante a validação humana nas soluções de IA?
questions.answer: A Mondria garante a validação humana nas soluções de IA incorporando a validação humana como parte da governança, que inclui também permissões, traçabilidade, segurança e conformidade desde a concepção. Isso é enfatizado no processo de governança para assegurar controle e qualidade nas soluções implementadas [MON-05-04, MON-04-03].

questions.question: Qu'est-ce que Etudia ?
questions.answer: Etudia est une solution d'intelligence artificielle proposée par Mondria pour les notaires du Québec. Elle est intégrée aux outils Teams, Outlook et Word. Les données utilisées sont hébergées au Québec et ne sont pas utilisées pour entraîner un modèle. Les fonctionnalités incluent la génération de documents, l'analyse du livre des minutes et les rappels de rendez-vous.

questions.question: Where is Etudia's data hosted?
questions.answer: Etudia's data is hosted in Quebec. The data is not used to train a model according to the information provided [MON-04-04].

questions.question: Mondria travaille-t-elle avec des OBNL ?
questions.answer: Oui, Mondria travaille avec des organismes sans but lucratif (OBNL). Cela fait partie des secteurs visés par leurs services, comme indiqué dans la navigation de leur site web. [MON-05-01]

questions.question: What's the difference between managed services and on-demand support?
questions.answer: Managed services aim to prevent problems through continuous monitoring and maintenance, while on-demand support intervenes after a problem occurs [MON-05-02].

questions.question: Por onde começar em cibersegurança, segundo a Mondria?
questions.answer: Segundo a Mondria, para começar em cibersegurança deve-se focar nos controles essenciais e priorizar conforme os riscos, especialmente em identidades, acessos, e-mails e estações de trabalho [MON-05-03].
